_comment: TEAM COMPLETION REWARDS: collect a franchise’s entire 2026-27 roster, earn that team’s reward card. THREE SECTIONS. `migrated` MOVES a card out of Super Season / Rookie / Summer Standouts into this set — it leaves its old set entirely, keeps its original badge, and gains the TEAM REWARD pill above it. `picks` builds a card from scratch for the three franchises nothing sensible could be moved to. `tiers` is the conference and full-set rewards, which are not franchise-bound. WHY MIGRATION. The ladder could not be built any other way: a franchise is hard to collect because its current roster is stacked, and those same franchises have had their history most thoroughly mined by the special sets, so the hardest rosters had the THINNEST fresh candidate pools. Only 3 of the 10 hardest could reach the legendary band from scratch; eight of the ten easiest could offer a better card than the median of the ten hardest. Moving the mined history back into rewards fixes supply without duplicating a single card. THE FLOOR (2026-09-30): a reward must beat the best card its roster asks for by $50, and may never be a player on that franchise's current roster; a pick that cannot carries a floorException saying why. The conference and whole-set rewards moved to card-data/set-rewards-2026.json the same day (the user: "I'd lean 'set.'").
